newsitem.title: UK: LME copper holds at $2,500 late.
newsitem.headline: LME copper holds at $2,500 late.

text.p: London Metal Exchange (LME) three months copper held at around the psychological $2,500 level in late inter-office activity on Wednesday.
The metal had finished the PM kerb $13 stronger at $2,506 per tonne after stalling at a high of $2,518. It was bid at $2,501 by 1800 GMT when Comex closed.
The Wednesday advance, building on a fund-buying and short-covering rally earlier this week, was eyed with caution by traders and analysts who noted the market was in overbought territory.
